speaker: HELIX
text: The shuttle bay is sealed. Z-shell only responds to the Zshellian Rift protocol.

speaker: HELIX
text: A session is a named container for your work. It persists even after you leave — unlike a process, it does not die when you walk away.

speaker: HELIX
text: The bridge terminal is the only exit. Open tmux and the ship will descend through session 0.

speaker: HELIX
text: Type: tmux — no flags, no arguments. The Rift will open and you will land in session 0.
